description: Estimate your ovulation day, fertile window and next period from your last period start and cycle length.

faqs.a: Ovulation is estimated at cycle length minus 14 days after your last period started. The fertile window covers the 5 days before ovulation through the day after, based on sperm and egg survival times.
No. Cycle-based estimates are not reliable contraception and cannot diagnose fertility issues. Do not use this to prevent pregnancy.
faqs.q: Can I use this as contraception?

faqs.a: They are calendar estimates from averages. Stress, illness and natural variation shift real ovulation by days — treat these as rough guidance only.

howto: Enter the first day of your last period.
Enter your average cycle length in days (21–35).
Check the fertile window and predicted next period.
title: Ovulation & Fertile Window Calculator
